entities.title: The page, looked at in a browser
entities.summary: The page, its drawing and its layout have been looked at by hand in headless Chromium; no automated test runs them.
criteria: A game can be started and played
Mobbed hunters are drawn as mobbed
The page fits a phone's screen, with the touch buttons under the game

checks.description: npm run build, serve dist/ with any static server, open /games/lundey/ and look at the title screen, a game in play, hunters while the terns mob them, and the page at a phone's size. Done by the coding agent in headless Chromium on 2026-11-27; no script repeats it.

notChecked: No automated test runs main.ts or anything in ui/ (render.ts, art.ts, input.ts, sound.ts): the tests have no browser.
Sound, swipes on a real touch screen and a gamepad were not among what was looked at.
No person has played the game (games/lundey/.dev/limitations.json, not-play-tested).
